subject: Taxes
title: Lincoln Creates the Tax Bureau
description: A 60-second lesson on Lincoln Creates the Tax Bureau.

hook.text: In 1862, Abraham Lincoln signed the Revenue Act, creating the Bureau of Internal Revenue.

buildup.text: The Union spent $2 million a day. Tariffs fell short. Lincoln created the first income tax: 3% on income over $800.

discovery.text: The bureau hired thousands of agents to collect the new tax.

twist.text: The tax was supposed to be temporary—lasting only until the war ended.

climax.text: Lincoln's wartime measure created the institution that now touches every American's life.

punchline.text: A war tax in 1862. The 'temporary' bureau is still here, 160+ years later.

quiz.question: Why did Lincoln create the Bureau of Internal Revenue?
options: To fund the Civil War through income tax
